'''AU Small Finance Bank Limited''' is an Indian [[Scheduled Banks (India)|scheduled commercial]] [[small finance bank]],<ref name="AU Bank Investor Presentation Q3FY19">{{Cite web|url=https://www.au.bank.in/sites/default/files/investor-presentation-Q3FY19.pdf|title=AU Bank Investor Presentation Q3FY19|access-date=28 March 2019|archive-date=28 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328113019/https://www.au.bank.in/sites/default/files/investor-presentation-Q3FY19.pdf|url-status=live}}</ref> headquartered in Mumbai. It was founded in 1996 as a vehicle finance company and was converted into a small finance bank in 2017. That same year, it got listed on [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/fortune-500/company/au-small-finance-bank?year=%20%202019|title=AU Small Finance Bank – Fortune 500 List 2019 – Fortune India|website=[[Fortune India]]}}</ref>

It received the "India's Top 50 Companies to Work for 2025" award from the Great Place to Work.<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdfs/press-release/2026/PR-final-27th-Apr.pdf |title=AU Small Finance Bank Announces Q4’FY26/FY26 Financial Results |publisher=AU Small Finance Bank |location=[[Jaipur]], India |page=5}}</ref> As on March 2026, the bank serves around 1.2 crore customers through (approx) 2790 touchpoints, across 21 states and 4 union territories. The same has been supported by 59,200+ workers and a balance sheet exceeding Rs. 1.9 lakh crore <ref>{{Cite web | title=AU Bank Capital House Inaugurated | url=https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260729102301/https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | access-date=2026-08-03 | archive-date=2026-07-29}}</ref>. 

==History==
The company was founded in 1996 by chartered accountant [[Sanjay Agarwal]] as AU Financiers (India) Ltd, a vehicle finance company and an [[NBFC and MFI in India|NBFC]]. It converted into a full-fledged [[small finance bank]] on 19 April 2017.<ref name=economictimes>{{cite web|last1=Mudgill|first1=Amit|title=AU Small Finance Bank IPO; here's what 8 brokerages say|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/au-small-finance-bank-ipo-heres-what-8-brokerages-say/articleshow/59339126.cms|website=The Economic Times|access-date=15 March 2018|date=28 June 2017|archive-date=15 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180315195921/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/au-small-finance-bank-ipo-heres-what-8-brokerages-say/articleshow/59339126.cms|url-status=live}}</ref> 

In 2003, the company received the RBI registration as an asset financing company. And in 2015, RBI gave the organisation an approval to set up a small finance bank <ref>{{Cite web |last=businessmodelcanvastemplate |date=2026-03-15 |title=What is Brief History of AU Small Finance Bank Company? |url=https://businessmodelcanvastemplate.com/blogs/brief-history/au-small-finance-bank-brief-history |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=Business Model Canvas Research |language=en}}</ref>.    

In 2012, associate company AU Insurance Broking Services Private Limited (established in 2011) received its Insurance Broking Agency License.<ref name=":1" />    

In the 2013, private equity firm ChrysCapital acquired a 10.01% stake in AU Financiers (now AU Small Finance Bank) for ₹120 crore through secondary market purchases from existing investors and founders.<ref name=":1">https://www.au.bank.in/au-journey</ref>

In November 2017, the [[Reserve Bank of India]] added the bank to [[Scheduled Banks (India)|its schedule of commercial banks]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Srivats|first1=K.R.|title=AU Small Finance gets scheduled commercial bank status|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/au-small-finance-gets-scheduled-commercial-bank-status/article9939601.ece|website=The Hindu Business Line|access-date=15 March 2018|language=en|date=2 November 2017|archive-date=7 February 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180207011213/http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/au-small-finance-gets-scheduled-commercial-bank-status/article9939601.ece|url-status=live}}</ref> In 2018, the bank was included in the Fortune India 500 list for the first time. In 2021, the bank launched AU 0101 digital banking app, and entered the credit card market <ref>{{Cite web |last=businessmodelcanvastemplate |date=2026-03-15 |title=What is Brief History of AU Small Finance Bank Company? |url=https://businessmodelcanvastemplate.com/blogs/brief-history/au-small-finance-bank-brief-history |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=Business Model Canvas Research |language=en}}</ref>. 

In 2023, they become the first small finance bank to offer 24x7 digital banking services <ref>{{Cite web |last=businessmodelcanvastemplate |date=2026-03-15 |title=What is Brief History of AU Small Finance Bank Company? |url=https://businessmodelcanvastemplate.com/blogs/brief-history/au-small-finance-bank-brief-history |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=Business Model Canvas Research |language=en}}</ref>. On 1 April 2024, AU Small Finance Bank completed the acquisition of Fincare Small Finance Bank through a [[stock swap]] merger, the first merger involving two small finance banks.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 29, 2023 |title=Fincare SFB to merge with AU Small Finance Bank in all-share deal |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/fincare-sfb-to-merge-with-au-small-finance-bank-in-all-share-deal-123102900985_1.html |access-date=October 31, 2024 |website=www.business-standard.com |archive-date=19 April 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240419110053/https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/fincare-sfb-to-merge-with-au-small-finance-bank-in-all-share-deal-123102900985_1.html |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Ray |first1=Atmadip |title=RBI approves AU Small Finance Bank acquisition of Fincare Small Finance Bank with effect from April 1 |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/rbi-approves-au-small-finance-bank-acquisition-of-fincare-small-finance-bank-with-effect-from-april-1/articleshow/108213476.cms |access-date=22 July 2025 |work=The Economic Times |date=4 March 2024}}</ref> 

On 7 August 2025, the Reserve Bank of India granted an in-principle approval to AU Small Finance Bank to transition into a [[universal bank]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=2025-08-07 |title=AU Small Finance Bank gets RBI nod to become a universal bank |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/au-small-finance-bank-gets-rbi-nod-to-become-a-universal-bank/articleshow/123171931.cms |access-date=2025-08-08 |work=The Times of India |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> making it the first small finance bank in India to receive such an approval.<ref>{{Cite news |date=August 8, 2025 |title=Business Standard |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/au-small-finance-bank-up-7-first-sfb-to-get-rbi-s-universal-bank-approval-125080800484_1.html}}</ref> It was also the first full-fledged banking license issued by the Reserve Bank of India in 11 years.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-08-07 |title=India's AU Small Finance Bank gets first universal banking licence in a decade |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indias-au-small-finance-bank-gets-first-universal-banking-licence-decade-2025-08-07/ |access-date=2025-08-08 |work=Reuters |language=en}}</ref> The same year, the bank crossed INR 1,50,000 crores in total business, including both deposits and advances as well <ref>{{Cite web |last=businessmodelcanvastemplate |date=2026-03-15 |title=What is Brief History of AU Small Finance Bank Company? |url=https://businessmodelcanvastemplate.com/blogs/brief-history/au-small-finance-bank-brief-history |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=Business Model Canvas Research |language=en}}</ref>. 

In February 2026, AU small finance bank launched a series of savings accounts for all customers. These bank accounts includes, AU Digital, AU Royale World, AU Platinum, AU Value and AU Vikaas <ref>{{Cite web |title=AU Small Finance Bank Launches Full Range of Savings Accounts for Every Customer Segment |url=https://thewire.in/ptiprnews/au-small-finance-bank-launches-full-range-of-savings-accounts-for-every-customer-segment |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=The Wire |language=en}}</ref>. The same has been built for women, senior citizens, students, NRIs and salaried professionals. Each variant of account is meant to serve the interests of different kinds of people, varied banking preferences and lifestyles <ref>{{Cite web |title=AU Small Finance Bank Launches Full Range of Savings Accounts for Every Customer Segment |url=https://thewire.in/ptiprnews/au-small-finance-bank-launches-full-range-of-savings-accounts-for-every-customer-segment |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=The Wire |language=en}}</ref>.   

In May 2026, the employee count of the bank declined due to the usage of AI and AI automation tools to increase productivity and business growth. The business momentum remained strong, and asset quality improved. The bank opined that this measure was farsighted, and will promote profits in the long runs <ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETBFSI.com |title=AU Bank says AI-led automation reduces employee count for first time |url=https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/au-small-finance-bank-utilizes-ai-to-reduce-workforce-for-first-time/132670513 |access-date=2026-07-29 |website=ETBFSI.com |language=en}}</ref>.    

In July 2026, AU Small Finance Bank announced the inauguration of its new office, 'AU Bank Capital House' at the World Trade Centre, New Delhi. The space will serve as the key office for the bank's senior leadership <ref>{{Cite web | title=AU Bank Capital House Inaugurated | url=https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260729102301/https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | access-date=2026-08-03 | archive-date=2026-07-29}}</ref>. The space also offers a full range of banking services, across retail, MSME, wholesale and digital segments, to serve the interests of customers and institutions. This will ensure that closer engagement, support seamless execution of strategic interventions and strengthening the presence of the organisation <ref>{{Cite web | title=AU Bank Capital House Inaugurated | url=https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260729102301/https://www.fintechbiznews.com/lenders-banks/au-bank-capital-house-inaugurated | access-date=2026-08-03 | archive-date=2026-07-29}}</ref>.    

== Operations ==
AU Small Finance Bank has a network of 2,726 physical touchpoints in 21 states and 4 union territories, 59,000+ staff, and a total customer base of about 1.25+ crore as of 30 April 2026.<ref>https://www.au.bank.in/about-us</ref>

=== CSR/BRSR Activities ===
The priorities of the sustainability activities of the bank includes economic, governance, social and environment. The sectors of impact was social development, building a better society by ensuring livelihood options, empowering women, skill enhancement, financial literacy and education <ref>{{Cite web| title=Sustainability initiatives - Staying true to our commitments  | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730174140/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>. The principles of these activities include ethics and governance, that is, trust and transparency was maintained among all stakeholders; sustainable products and services; employee welfare; responsiveness towards stakeholders; respect and promotion of human rights; environment protection; advocacy of public policy; inclusive growth; and customer value <ref>{{Cite web| title=Sustainability initiatives - Staying true to our commitments  | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730174140/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>. The programmes undertaken by the bank includes- AU Udyogini (empowering women entrepreneurship), AU Skills Academy (Empowering Self-Reliance), Sports for Development (Making a healthier India), and Financial and Digital Literacy Initiative (Empowering with financial knoweldge and wisdom) <ref>{{Cite web| title=Sustainability initiatives - Staying true to our commitments  | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730174140/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>.    

Another one of the key initiatives of the bank is financial exclusion. According to the BRSR report of FY20, they undertook different policies to ensure that more people come under the ambit of financial banking <ref>{{Cite web| title=Sustainability initiatives - Staying true to our commitments  | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730174140/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>. These policies included priority sector lending, financial literacy and education, driving financial inclusion through technology and through employees that take services to many underbanked areas.      

Environmentally, there were many initiatives undertaken by the bank to ensure that a sustainable impact was made by the bank. This includes reduction of carbon footprint through conservation of energy, advanced setting power use interface, reduction in fuel consumption, among many initiatives. Virtualising information centres and servers, managing energy through e-waste management, and technology absorption, were other significant endeavours pursued by the bank <ref>{{Cite web| title=Sustainability initiatives - Staying true to our commitments  | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730174140/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/Business-Responsibility-Report.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>.       

== Employees ==
The office has been made accessible and, according to [[Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016]], and the Harmonized Guidelines for Standards of Accessibility. As of the latest year of reporting, 28 disabled people individuals <ref>{{Cite web| title=Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report FY 2024-25 | url=https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/BRSR-2025.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260730191743/https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/BRSR-2025.pdf | archive-date=2026-07-30}}</ref>. The office has provided the disabled employees with a bunch of accessibility facilities, like braille-signages and wheelchair-friendly pathways. The diversity and inclusion wing of the bank has also ensured that there is a strict compliance to a non-discriminatory work environment that promotes a lack of bias <ref>https://www.au.bank.in/pdf/reporting/BRSR-2025.pdf

</ref>.      

== Other Initiatives ==

=== Suhana Safar ===
AU Small Finance Bank, in partnership with [[Maruti Suzuki]] India launched an industry-first initiative called 'Suhana Safar'. This is a unique Recurring Deposit backed auto loan scheme is meant to make car ownership more accessible to first-time buyers <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-03 |title=AU Small Finance Bank and Maruti Suzuki Launch 'Suhana Safar |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-and-maruti-suzuki-launch-suhana-safar-351209.html |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref>. This addresses one of the key problems of buying a car- mobilising a lump sum down payment and committing to an EMI. This structured, RD-backed solution helps customers to build savings, earn interest, and practically assess their comfort with making regular payments before availing the auto loan <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-03 |title=AU Small Finance Bank and Maruti Suzuki Launch 'Suhana Safar |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-and-maruti-suzuki-launch-suhana-safar-351209.html |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref>. The scheme offers a seamless, end-to-end journey from disciplined savings to car ownership. This process involves opening the RD, monthly deposits, earning interest, down payment conversion and loan disbursement <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-03 |title=AU Small Finance Bank and Maruti Suzuki Launch 'Suhana Safar |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-and-maruti-suzuki-launch-suhana-safar-351209.html |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref>. The 'Suhana Safar' scheme is available through all of the authorised Maruti Suzuki dealerships. The same can be availed for the models [[Alto K10]], [[Suzuki S-Presso|S-Presso]], Celerio, and [[WagonR]] <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-03 |title=AU Small Finance Bank and Maruti Suzuki Launch 'Suhana Safar |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-and-maruti-suzuki-launch-suhana-safar-351209.html |access-date=2026-07-28 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref>.      

=== Sustainability ===
In July 2026, AU SFB organised a mega tree plantation drive in [[Hyderabad]], India. The same was done through the CSR arm of the bank, the AU foundation <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-17 |title=AU Small Finance Bank Celebrates Van Mahotsav with Tree Plantation Drive in Hyderabad |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-celebrates-van-mahotsav-with-tree-plantation-drive-in-hyderabad-353552.html |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref>. The same was aligned with the Ministry of Education's campaign, "Ek Ped Maa ke Naam 3.0". The primary objective of this is to restore ecological balance while instilling values of environmental accountability within the communities <ref>{{Cite web |last=Vishal |date=2026-07-17 |title=AU Small Finance Bank Celebrates Van Mahotsav with Tree Plantation Drive in Hyderabad |url=https://www.telugutimes.net/en/bnews/au-small-finance-bank-celebrates-van-mahotsav-with-tree-plantation-drive-in-hyderabad-353552.html |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=English site |language=en}}</ref> .  

== Controversies ==
On 18 February 2026, AU Small Finance Bank was [[Haryana Government accounts fraud|de-empanelled]] by the [[Government of Haryana]] along with [[IDFC First Bank]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Iyer |first=Archishma |date=23 February 2026 |title=De-empanelled by Haryana, AU Small Finance Bank opens probe, sends staff 'offduty' |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/de-empanelled-by-haryana-au-small-finance-bank-opens-probe-sends-staff-offduty-13839206.html |access-date=24 February 2026 |work=[[Moneycontrol]]}}</ref> The state questioned the bank over suspected unauthorised transactions of about {{INRConvert|72|c|year=2026}}, including {{INRConvert|47|c|year=2026}} transferred in 14 transactions from a government account to a customer account.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Fernandes |first=Jocelyn |date=2026-02-23 |title=AU Small Finance Bank de-empanelment: What we know about ₹47 crore funds transfer, timeline, internal review details {{!}} Company Business News |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/au-small-finance-bank-clarify-de-empanelment-haryana-govt-account-transactions-internal-review-assess-reasons-idfc-first-11771811075341.html |access-date=2026-02-24 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref> The bank said the transactions were properly authorised and denied any wrongdoing.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sarkar |first=Subhojit |date=2026-02-23 |title=AU Small Finance Bank denies wrongdoing after Haryana govt de-empanels it over alleged fraud |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/business-news/au-small-finance-bank-denies-wrongdoing-after-haryana-govt-de-empanels-it-over-alleged-fraud/130632 |access-date=2026-02-24 |website=Fortune India |language=en}}</ref> However, the bank has initiated an internal review, placed certain employees off duty pending the process.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2026-02-24 |title=AU Small Finance Bank begins internal probe after Haryana account fiasco |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/au-small-finance-bank-begins-internal-probe-after-haryana-account-fiasco/articleshow/128727078.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-02-24 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref>

extract:
AU Small Finance Bank Limited is an Indian scheduled commercial small finance bank, headquartered in Mumbai. It was founded in 1996 as a vehicle finance company and was converted into a small finance bank in 2017. That same year, it got listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
It received the "India's Top 50 Companies to Work for 2025" award from the Great Place to Work. As on March 2026, the bank serves around 1.2 crore customers through (approx) 2790 touchpoints, across 21 states and 4 union territories. The same has been supported by 59,200+ workers and a balance sheet exceeding Rs. 1.9 lakh crore .
